name: Shepherd University
academic_ranking: Public 4-year regional university in Shepherdstown, WV. Enrollment ~3,339 (about 3,032 undergraduate), student-to-faculty ratio 17:1, rural campus setting. Acceptance rate ~97%; 6-year graduation rate ~51%.
financial_aid: In-state tuition and fees ~$9,056/yr; out-of-state ~$19,082/yr (NCES 2024-2025). ~98% of full-time beginning undergrads received some financial aid; ~96% received grant/scholarship aid (avg $8,241); ~40% received Pell grants; average net price ~$11,744.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at the Shepherd University softball complex on the Shepherdstown, WV campus. No detailed public facilities description captured from the softball program page (checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Pennsylvania State Athletic Conference (PSAC), one of the premier D2 conferences.
notes: Staff directory and roster fetched from shepherdrams.com softball pages 2026-07. Coaching staff listed as head coach plus one assistant. Tuition/financial-aid figures sourced from NCES College Navigator (IPEDS ID 237792). Scholarship count not publicly listed.
